更新记录What’s New

每一次版本更新都写在这里，最新的一版排在最上面。 Every release and improvement, newest first.

0.1.0 · 首个公开版0.1.0 · First Public Release 2026-11-23
  • 阅读与书架Reading
    安静的本地书房：支持在 Mac、Android、iPhone 与 iPad 上打开 EPUB、PDF、TXT 与无加密 MOBI / AZW3 电子书（Windows 端开发中），内置多套纸张与单双栏排版；支持 Wi‑Fi 无线传书与连接家庭书库。 A quiet local library: read EPUB, PDF, TXT, and DRM-free MOBI / AZW3 across Mac, Android, iPhone, and iPad (Windows in progress) with custom papers, local Wi‑Fi transfer, and home library connections.
  • 逐句听读Read Aloud
    点任意一句开始朗读，墨线跟着声音逐句推进、自动翻页；支持本机离线声音、系统声音与自接云端人声，锁屏和耳机线控都能切句暂停。 Tap any sentence to hear it aloud as the ink line moves forward and pages turn automatically—supporting local offline voices, system voices, cloud voices, and lock-screen controls.
  • 播客与有声Podcasts
    订阅播客节目或导入有声书，排成清爽可查词、可划原声切片的阅读页（有声书录音对齐与分角色朗读亦在持续打磨中）。 Subscribe to podcasts or import audiobooks into readable, searchable pages where you can look up words and save audio clips (forced alignment and character voices continue in active polish).
  • 外文与书伴Companion
    外文书支持离线查词、行间难词简注、双击整句翻译与生词本；防剧透「书伴」默认只在你已读过的部分里回答，每句话都能直接点回原文。 Offline dictionary, subtle interlinear glosses, sentence translation, and word list—paired with a spoiler-free Reading Companion grounded strictly in what you’ve already read.
  • 笔记与回顾Notes
    多样式划线、想法、今日回顾、书摘卡片与纸书记录；随时一键导出到 Markdown、Obsidian、Notion、flomo、新枝、Anki、带划线的 EPUB 与阅读记录表。 Multi-style highlights, thoughts, Daily Review, quote cards, and paper-book logging—exportable to Markdown, Obsidian, Notion, flomo, Xinzhi, Anki, highlighted EPUB, and CSV.
  • 同步与反馈Sync
    经由你自己的 iCloud 云盘或私人网盘同步阅读进度、划线与播客（遇到冲突并排自选），支持整库一键备份，以及应用内直接反馈问题。 Sync progress, notes, and podcasts via your own iCloud Drive or personal cloud storage with side-by-side conflict resolution, full-library backups, and private in-app feedback.
